Sample.evidence_source: [page/1/Text/14] A comparison of the 22 participants who completed the study and the 8 who did not revealed no significant differences on Time 1 measures

IPT.evidence_source: [page/1/Text/17] The effects of bibliotherapy on depressive severity and cognitive measures were assessed by five 2x 2 (Condition x Time) repeated measures ANOVAs, with the depression and cognitive measures as the dependent variables.

dxgive.evidence_source: [page/1/Text/15] We compared the immediate-treatment and delayed-treatment conditions on age, gender, race, reading comprehension, and initial levels of depressive symptoms to determine if there were any significant differences between the two conditions before treatment.

Source.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/4] Note.
